title: Senior Manager, Innovation Quality
text:
**About Liquid I.V.**
This job description indicates in general the nature and levels of work, knowledge, skills, abilities and other essential functions expected of the role. It is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities required. It is not intended to limit or in any way modify the right of any supervisor to assign, direct, and control the work of employees under his/her supervision. Ability to competently perform all the essential duties of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation, demonstrated commitment to the company’s mission, and the ability to work productively as a member of a team or work group are basic requirements of all positions at Liquid I.V.
 
 
We are committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve. We know that the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives that encourage new ways of solving problems, so we strive to attract and develop talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels seen, heard, and empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work.
 
 
Liquid I.V. is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.
 
 
**About Our Team**
We are a world-class team of innovators and passionate change-makers, looking to develop transformative hydration solutions and make a meaningful impact on the world around us.
 
 
At Liquid I.V., we are committed to building an inclusive culture of belonging that not only embraces the diversity of our people but also reflects the diversity of the communities in which we work and the customers we serve.
 
 
Our team members enjoy a flexible and inclusive working environment, a highly collaborative and innovation-forward culture, generous benefits and perks that empower employees to champion their wellbeing every day, as well as an infinite supply of Liquid I.V. for extraordinary hydration.
 
 
**About The Role**
The Senior Manager, Innovation Quality will lead Quality across the Innovation Growth Team, ensuring products are designed, commercialized and manufactured to meet applicable company, regulatory and food-safety requirements. This role is accountable for establishing and applying Quality standards across raw materials, formulations, packaging, manufacturing processes and finished products, from development through ongoing commercial production.
 
 
As the primary Quality representative for the team, this individual will lead the overall Quality workstream while connecting with specialists across Supplier Quality, Analytical, Microbiology, Customer Quality and other functions as needed. The role requires a well-rounded Quality professional who can independently lead complex work, apply strong technical judgment and build Quality systems and ways of working that can scale with the business.
 
 
**Functions and duties of this role include, but not limited to:**
**Build the Innovation Quality Capability**

* Develop and implement a scalable Quality framework supporting innovation, commercialization and ongoing production.
* Translate company, enterprise and applicable regulatory requirements into fit-for-purpose Quality standards and specifications.
* Identify gaps in existing standards, systems or capabilities and lead development of appropriate solutions.
* Establish effective processes for specifications, release, change control, deviations, CAPA, documentation and Quality performance.
* Define Quality governance, decision rights and escalation pathways across internal teams and external partners.
* Continuously strengthen Quality systems and ways of working as business needs evolve.

**Own End-to-End Product Quality**

* Ensure raw materials, formulations, packaging, manufacturing processes and finished products meet established Quality, food-safety and regulatory requirements.
* Establish or coordinate Quality specifications, testing requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Partner with R&D to ensure product and formulation designs consistently meet Quality requirements throughout the product lifecycle.
* Ensure packaging meets appropriate Quality, compatibility and validation requirements.
* Partner with R&D Commercialization, Supply Chain and manufacturing partners to ensure commercial processes consistently deliver against established specifications.
* Establish appropriate Quality controls from incoming materials through manufacturing, release and ongoing production.

**Lead Quality Through Commercialization and Scale-Up**

* Lead Quality activities through development, plant trials, commercialization, validation, launch and post-launch stabilization.
* Define Quality requirements and deliverables at key project milestones.
* Establish Quality plans for manufacturing trials and scale-up, including testing, sampling, acceptance criteria and escalation requirements.
* Assess product, process and manufacturing-site readiness prior to commercial production.
* Identify and mitigate Quality risks and provide clear recommendations supporting commercialization decisions.
* Monitor early commercial production and ensure emerging Quality issues are effectively resolved.

**Serve as the Quality Integrator**

* Serve as the primary Quality representative within cross-functional project teams and leadership forums.
* Own the integrated Quality workplan, including key deliverables, dependencies, risks and decisions.
* Engage appropriate expertise across Supplier Quality, Analytical, Microbiology, Customer Quality and other technical functions.
* Translate specialist input into actionable project requirements and decisions.
* Coordinate Quality activities across internal functions, laboratories, suppliers and external manufacturers.
* Proactively identify and escalate Quality risks affecting consumers, products, commercialization or continuity of supply.

**Support External Manufacturing and Commercial Production**

* Lead Quality activities associated with qualification, onboarding and ongoing management of external manufacturing partners.
* Partner with Supplier Quality and Procurement to ensure material and packaging suppliers meet applicable requirements.
* Establish Quality agreements, specifications, controls and performance expectations with external partners.
* Ensure appropriate GMP, food-safety, sanitation, traceability, process-control and product-release systems are in place.
* Monitor Quality performance and lead responses to significant deviations, non-conformances and out-of-specification results.
* Ensure robust root-cause analysis, CAPA and verification of effectiveness.
* Apply commercial-production learnings to continuously strengthen Quality standards and processes.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Food Engineering, Microbiology, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of progressive Quality experience in food, beverage or consumer packaged goods manufacturing, with demonstrated breadth across multiple Quality disciplines.
* Direct, hands-on Quality experience in dry powders and liquid beverage manufacturing environments, including exposure to commercialization, scale-up and/or ongoing production.
* PCQI and/or HACCP certification; familiarity with SQF, BRCGS, FSSC 22000 or comparable certification schemes.
* Proven experience supporting consumer products through commercialization and transition into routine commercial production.
* Strong understanding of commercial manufacturing, process controls and Quality systems.
* Experience establishing or implementing Quality requirements across raw materials, product/formulation attributes, packaging, manufacturing processes and finished products.
* Experience working with external manufacturers, co-manufacturers and suppliers.
* Working knowledge of applicable U.S. food regulations, HACCP, GMPs, preventive controls and recognized food-safety and Quality-management systems.
* Experience with manufacturing trials, validation, product release, specifications, change control, deviations, CAPA and root-cause investigations.
* Proven ability to lead complex cross-functional work and effectively engage technical specialists across multiple Quality disciplines.
* Strong project-management skills with the ability to manage interconnected deliverables, risks, decisions and timelines.
* Strong technical judgment and ability to make risk-based Quality decisions in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

**Preferred**

* Quality experience across multiple food and/or beverage product formats and manufacturing technologies.
* Experience performing and assessing supplier GMP audits against CFR 111 and 117 requirements
* Experience establishing or evolving Quality systems within a growing or changing manufacturing environment.
* Experience managing Quality across multiple external manufacturing partners or locations.
* Experience working in both large consumer-products organizations and fast-paced innovation environments.
* Experience supporting high-growth commercialization and manufacturing scale-up.

**What We Give**

* 100% company-paid medical, dental and vision insurance for employees (PPO, HMO and Kaiser options).
* A 401k plan with company match, short and long-term disability coverage.
* A generous PTO and sick leave programs that includes 10+ paid annual holidays each year + annual Holiday Office Closure.
* Wellness Days (Vitality Day and two Recharge Days).
* An Employee Assistance Program
* Monthly tech and wellness reimbursement.
* An infinite supply of Liquid I.V. for endless hydration!

**Work Environment**

* This role is HYBRID (El Segundo, CA) 1-2 times in office with flexibility for industry events. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

The compensation band for this position is
**$116,100- $165,000**
annually. The exact salary is determined by various factors including experience, skills, education, geographic location, internal company equity, and budget. The listed range is applicable only to the annual base salary and does not include additional perks, benefits, or applicable bonus eligibility comprising the total compensation package.
